decisions.reason: As an extension of established sports-flooring capabilities in a growing industry, it is likely to be carried forward unless its results clearly fell short of aspiration.
This specialized mobile arena floor is more likely to have underperformed aspiration in a disrupted sports-events market, prompting a shift of resources back to stronger lines.
A second mobile arena system looks especially vulnerable to portfolio pruning if demand was weak, because comparable internal alternatives raise the pressure to redeploy resources.
The chevron parquet fits the firm's core trend-led premium flooring strategy very closely, so satisfactory performance is more likely and gives little reason to search for alternatives.
The squash court finish serves a narrow niche outside the firm's main style-oriented growth path, so any shortfall versus aspiration would make dropping it likely.
As a low-cost complementary accessory for an established sports-floor offer, it can be retained under available slack even if demand is only moderate.
